title: Slub Cotton Blend Polo Sweater — Hazelnut Melange
description: This sweater is knitted from a slub cotton-linen blend giving it a textural finish and melange color effect. It has a regular fit and features a polo collar with corozo buttons, tonal embroidery at the chest and rib endings at the hem and cuffs.

title: Striped Polo Sweater — Vintage Blue
description: Crafted in an airy textured cotton knit, this polo sweater is a preppy, comfortable addition to your wardrobe. Featuring a sleek striped pattern and regular fit, it is designed with a polo collar and full buttoned placket, corozo buttons and ribbed endings at the hem and sleeve cuffs.

title: Cotton Cable Knit Half-Zip Sweater — Oat Melange
description: Designed in cotton with an all-over cable knit structure, this soft sweater has a regular fit and a half-zip collar. A preppy essential, it is detailed with our iconic Archive Shield graphic embroidered at the chest and features rib endings at the neck, hem and cuffs.

title: Cable Knit Crew Neck Sweater — Light Blue
description: An American sportswear classic, the cable knit sweater has roots with the Aran Islands and Irish fisherman, but has been adored by everyone from Hollywood film stars to boarding school students around the world. Crafted from a soft cotton elastane blend for a slim yet stretchy fit, our version keeps it crisp and versatile with ribbed details, a classic crew neck, and our signature shield graphic embroidered at the chest. Plus, in a range of neutrals and vibrant seasonal hues, you can justify one in every color.

title: Indigo Cable Knit Sweater — Rich Navy
description: This sweater is made using indigo-dyed cotton yarn that's been knitted in a textured cable structure. It's designed for a regular fit and has a ribbed crew neck with a rolled edge.

title: Reversible Lightweight Coat — Oat Beige
description: Inspired by the Gant archives and classic wind coat styles, this outerwear piece is a versatile icon. Crafted in a cotton poplin blend and embracing a relaxed fit, it is fully reversible with a contrasting checked pattern at the interior. This coat is treated with a water-repellent finish and features a corduroy collar, welt and patch pockets, button adjusters at the cuffs and a branded locker loop at the back. This garment is intended for a relaxed fit. For a closer fit, we recommend sizing down.\n\nThis coat features a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment which will help to shed water in light weather conditions.

title: Quilted Windcheater Mid-Length Jacket — Black
description: Crafted in a diamond quilting structure, this windcheater jacket is made entirely from recycled polyester and treated with a water-repellent finish. Cut for a mid-length and a regular fit, it features a stand collar and center front placket with press buttons and a hidden zip closure underneath. Other design elements include side hand-warming pockets, lower flap packets and two interior pockets. This jacket is complete with branded embroidery at the chest and at the back locker loop.    This jacket features a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment which will help to shed water in light weather conditions.

title: Short Leather Trench Coat — Black
description: Sure to become the most-loved piece in your outerwear collection, this short trench coat is crafted from super soft lamb's leather for a premium feel. Designed with a relaxed-fitting silhouette, it has raglan sleeves and a length that finishes right at the hips. Fully lined, it features welt pockets, an interior pocket, branded imitation horn buttons and a removable belt at the waist to accentuate and define your shape. This garment is intended for a relaxed fit. For a closer fit, we recommend sizing down.

title: Light Down Jacket — Warm Khaki
description: An easy, year-round layering piece with 90% down and 10% feathers, the Light Down Jacket is made from super light and certified recycled polyester with a water-repellent finish. The piece has a regular fit with a straight hem and a slightly shorter length that makes it ideal to be worn alone over shirts or under heavier coats on colder days. A stand collar, lacquered snaps, angled welt pockets, a two-way zipper, and a printed logo at the chest complete the piece.  This jacket features a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment which will help to shed water in light weather conditions.

title: Linen Cap Sleeve Shirt Dress — Fresh Soil
description: Made from certified European flax linen, a naturally breathable and lightweight fiber, this dress is designed for a relaxed fit and a mid-thigh length. It has folded cap sleeves, side seam pockets, and a point collar with a hidden front placket. This dress can be cinched at the waist with a self-tie belt. This garment is intended for a relaxed fit. For a closer fit, we recommend sizing down.

title: Popover Linen Dress — White
description: Made from certified European flax linen, a naturally breathable and lightweight fiber, this dress is designed for a relaxed fit and has a length that skims just above the knees.
